title: Neon District
summary: A dense realtime city block built for headset walkthroughs.
description: A modular night-city environment focused on lighting, density, and performance on standalone VR. Packaged as a walkthrough experience with baked GI and a lean prop kit. Placeholder project until the real case study lands.

title: Atelier Visualization
summary: Architectural walkthrough for a renovation proposal.
description: Realtime presentation of a residential interior — materials, soft lighting, and a guided camera path for client review. Built to iterate fast between design meetings.

title: Glyph Set
summary: A compact icon and mark system for a product launch.
description: Grid-based glyphs with a small family of variants. Designed to work at UI sizes and as larger print marks without losing structure.

title: This Portfolio
summary: The site you're looking at — static, tagged, and still under construction.
description: A black-and-white one-pager with frosted glass, tag filters, and a local configurator in the works. Built to stay free to host and easy to update without a CMS.
